verdict.rationale: Expensify's AI assistant can create, categorize, tag, approve, and reject expenses in plain language, and finalized reports export automatically to QuickBooks Online. An API with credentials also exists. However, no evidence says any of these act on many items at once, so bulk capability is only implied. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operations across many expenses or reports, documented bulk API endpoints, examples of the AI applying one action to multiple items, independent or hands-on corroboration.
